'''Sharn eggs''' were a type of [[Egg/Legends|egg]] that were laid by [[Sharn]]s. They were once used by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on one of their many training exercises.<ref name="Crucible (novel)">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>
